$comment: Path-detectable skill triggers enforced by scripts/skill-gate.mjs (a PreToolUse hook). 'always' skills are required for every non-exempt edit; each rule adds skills when an edited path matches any 'when' glob. Edit this table to tighten or extend coverage. Intent-only skills that a hook cannot detect (code-review, release-flow, end-to-end-api-flow, observability, security-testing-policy, jsx-component-extraction) stay governed by AGENTS.md. Opt out with SKILL_GATE_DISABLE=1.
